caption:
Phones lose signal in lifts, metros and basements. Your users will hit this.

With the network off, fetch rejects with a TypeError. If your code has no catch, or turns the spinner off only on success, it spins forever. The user taps again, or leaves.

Check three things: the error is shown in plain words, there's a way to retry, and the button works again afterwards. Then switch to Slow 4G and see what a long wait looks like.

Source: MDN, Window.fetch() (exceptions), and Chrome DevTools docs (Network panel, Offline).
